The '''DT-125 magna-safe''' was a model of [[magna-lock safe]] made by [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]]. The DT-125, like other magna-lock safes, made use of [[Magna lock/Legends|magna locks]] in order to safely secure their contents. The [[safe]] cost upwards of 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
